title: MEP-Electrical
description:
RPJ Design & BIM Solution, Nagpur, is looking for experienced BIM professionals to work on a Data Center Project involving multidisciplinary BIM modeling, coordination, clash detection, and construction documentation.

Responsibilities:
Job Responsibilities – BIM Project Coordination
- Client Coordination: Coordinate with clients to understand project requirements, clarify technical queries, follow up on deliverables, and maintain effective communication.
- Project Reporting: Prepare and share daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports, including completed work, pending tasks, milestones, and project status.
- Weekly Meetings: Schedule and conduct weekly project coordination meetings with clients and internal teams to discuss progress, challenges, deadlines, and action items.
- Team Management: Manage and coordinate the BIM team, allocate tasks, monitor productivity, and ensure timely project delivery.
- ETM Management: Handle ETM (as per the project's defined ETM process), coordinate with relevant stakeholders, and track updates and pending actions.
- Issue and Risk Management: Identify project issues, coordinate resolutions, maintain issue logs, and follow up on RFIs and technical clarifications.
- Milestone Tracking: Monitor project milestones, submission schedules, client feedback, and approval status.
- Documentation: Maintain meeting minutes (MoM), action trackers, project reports, and other project-related documentation.
- BIM Coordination: Coordinate architectural, structural, and MEPF teams to support model coordination, clash detection, and quality control.
Suggested Job Title: BIM Project Coordinator / BIM Project Engineer

Requirements:
Revit & BIM Standards, Navisworks Clash Detection, ISO 19650 Compliance

title: Structural Engineer
description:
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented *Structural Engineer* with *1–2 years of experience* to join our engineering team. The candidate will be responsible for structural analysis, design, detailing, and coordination of various structural projects while ensuring compliance with applicable codes and standards.

Responsibilities:
* Perform structural analysis and design for residential, commercial, and industrial projects.
* Prepare structural calculations, drawings, and design documentation.
* Develop RCC and steel structural designs as per project requirements.
* Prepare and review structural drawings using AutoCAD and relevant design software.
* Conduct load _calculations and ensure structural stability and safety.
* Coordinate with_ architects, civil engineers, MEP teams, and other project stakeholders.
* Review drawings and identify design or construction-related issues.
* Assist in site inspections and provide technical support during construction.
* Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications.
* Maintain accurate engineering documentation and project records.
* Support senior engineers in project planning, design reviews, and technical coordination.

Requirements:
* Bachelor’s degree in *Civil Engineering / Structural Engineering*.
* 1–2 years of relevant experience in structural design and analysis.
* Good knowledge of *RCC and steel structure design*.
* Familiarity with structural analysis and design principles.
* Knowledge of relevant *IS Codes and design standards*.
* Proficiency in *AutoCAD* for structural drawings and detailing.

title: MEPF BIM Modeler
description:
The MEPF BIM Modeler is responsible for developing, updating, and coordinating accurate BIM models for Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Fighting (MEPF) systems.
The role ensures that MEPF models are execution-ready, clash-free, and compliant with BIM standards and project requirements.
The MEPF BIM Modeler supports interdisciplinary coordination, documentation, and construction outputs through high-quality BIM modeling.

Responsibilities:
1. MEPF BIM Model Development
•	Develop detailed MEPF BIM models in Autodesk Revit as per drawings, specifications, and BEP
•	Model Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and Fire Fighting systems accurately
•	Maintain required Level of Development (LOD) as per project stage
•	Ensure models are suitable for coordination and construction use

2. Model Quality, Accuracy & Standards
•	Ensure accuracy and completeness of MEPF BIM models
•	Follow company BIM standards, templates, and naming conventions
•	Ensure correct use of levels, grids, coordinates, and worksets
•	Prevent modeling errors and inconsistencies

3. Inter-Discipline Coordination & Clash Support
•	Coordinate MEPF models with Architectural and Structural BIM models
•	Participate in clash detection using Navisworks
•	Implement approved clash resolutions
•	Support coordination reviews and meetings

4. Drawing, Quantity & Output Preparation
•	Prepare coordinated layouts, shop drawings, and construction drawings
•	Extract quantities, schedules, and BOQs from BIM models
•	Ensure drawings are clear, accurate, and execution-ready

5. Change Management & Version Control
•	Update models based on design changes, RFIs, and site inputs
•	Ensure proper version control and file management
•	Prevent usage of outdated models and drawings

6. Productivity & Timelines
•	Complete assigned modeling tasks within agreed timelines
•	Meet internal and client delivery schedules
•	Maintain consistent output without compromising quality

7. Coordination with Team & Stakeholders
•	Coordinate with BIM Coordinators and Team Leads
•	Clarify BIM-related technical queries
•	Support interdisciplinary coordination requirements

8. Reporting & Task Updates
•	Submit regular task progress updates
•	Highlight risks or delays impacting deliverables
•	Maintain task logs and revision records

9. Continuous Improvement & Skill Development
•	Upgrade BIM skills, tools, and workflows
•	Follow best practices in BIM modeling
•	Support process improvements and automation initiatives

10. Client Coordination, Site Support & Team Development
•	Attend client meetings and client office visits for project discussions and progress reviews. 
•	Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution. 
•	Conduct site visits as required by the client for verification, issue resolution, and project support. 
•	Lead and guide junior BIM modelers in daily project activities. 
•	Provide technical training, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing sessions to team members. 
•	Support resource planning and ensure timely completion of assigned deliverables.

Requirements:
Revit & BIM Standards, AutoCAD & Civil 3D, Navisworks Clash Detection etc....

title: BIM Engineer
description:
NICVDC is looking for a skilled and motivated BIM Engineer to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for BIM modeling, drawing production, coordination, clash detection, and supporting project teams across architectural, structural, and MEP disciplines.
Key Responsibilities
Develop accurate 3D BIM models based on project drawings, standards, and client requirements.
Prepare Shop Drawings, Construction Drawings, and As-Built Drawings.
Work on Architectural, Structural, and/or MEP BIM models.
Perform model coordination and identify clashes using Navisworks Manage.
Coordinate with architects, engineers, consultants, and internal project teams.
Create and manage Revit families, schedules, sheets, views, and documentation.

Responsibilities:
- Create and update accurate BIM models using Autodesk Revit.
- Prepare Architectural, Structural and MEP drawings as per project requirements.
- Develop Shop Drawings, Coordination Drawings and As-Built Drawings.
- Perform clash detection and coordination using Navisworks.
- Coordinate with architects, engineers, consultants and other project stakeholders.
- Resolve model coordination issues and incorporate project comments/revisions.
- Prepare sheets, schedules, families and project documentation in Revit.
- Maintain model quality and follow BIM standards, templates and naming conventions.
- Support multidisciplinary BIM coordination meetings and project submissions.
- Ensure assigned models and drawings are delivered accurately and within project timelines.

Requirements:
- Strong knowledge of Autodesk Revit
- Good working knowledge of AutoCAD & Navisworks Manage
- Experience in BIM Modeling and Coordination
- Ability to work on LOD 300–400 models
- Knowledge of Clash Detection and Clash Resolution
- Ability to prepare Shop Drawings, Coordination Drawings & As-Built Drawings
- Understanding of Revit Families, Schedules, Sheets and Worksets
- Ability to read Architectural, Structural and MEP drawings
- Basic knowledge of ACC / BIM 360
- Good understanding of BIM standards and QA/QC process
